articles.heading: Isobanura Muri iri tegeko ngenga
articles.text:
(a) “Ambasade y’u Rwanda”
hakubiyemo ahantu hose hari mu ifasi
y’ibiro bihagarariye u Rwanda mu
mahanga;
(b) “Ambasaderi” bivuga uhagarariye u
Rwanda mu gihugu cy’amahanga;
(c) “gutangaza ibyavuye mu itora”
bivuga gushyira ahagaragara ibyavuye
mu itora bikozwe n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha nyuma yo guhuriza hamwe
ibyavuye mu itora byaturutse ku nzego
zose itora ryabereyeho;
(d) “ibiro by’itora” bivuga inyubako
igenwa na Komisiyo igizwe nibura
n’icyumba cy’itora kimwe;
(e) “icyumba cy’itora” bivuga icyumba
kigenwa na Komisiyo gitorerwamo
n’abantu bemerewe gutora kandi bari
ku ilisiti y’itora;
(f) “ikarita ndangamuntu” bivuga
icyangombwa gifatika cyangwa
icyangombwa koranabuhanga kiranga
umuntu gitangwa n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha;
(g) “ilisiti y’itora” bivuga inyandiko
ikubiyemo imyirondoro y’abantu
bemerewe gutora;
(h) “impfabusa” bivuga ijwi ry’utora
rigaragazwa n’ibimenyetso
bitandukanye n’ibyateganyijwe
gukoreshwa mu itora cyangwa ritagira
ikimenyetso;
(i) “inararibonye” bivuga umuntu
wakoze imirimo ihambaye igihe
kirekire, ufite ubuhanga cyangwa
ubumenyi yakuye mu bikorwa byinshi
yakoze ugereranyije n’inshingano
z’umwanya utorerwa;
(j) “indorerezi y’itora” bivuga
Umunyarwanda cyangwa
umunyamahanga uba ari intumwa
y’umuryango nyarwanda utari uwa
Leta, ihuriro ry’imiryango nyarwanda
itari iya Leta, umuryango ushingiye ku
myemerere, urwego rwa Leta, Igihugu,
umuryango mpuzamahanga cyangwa
mvamahanga, byemererwa na
Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Amatora
gukurikirana ibikorwa by’amatora;
(k) “inteko itora” bivuga itsinda
ry’abantu bafite uburenganzira bwo
gutora;
(l) “inyangamugayo” bivuga
Umunyarwanda w’indakemwa mu
myifatire no mu mibanire ye n’abandi;
(m)“itora” bivuga igikorwa gituma
habaho guhitamo binyuze mu itora;
(n) “itora ritaziguye” bivuga uburyo bwo
gutora aho utora yitorera ku giti cye;
(o) “itora riziguye” bivuga uburyo bwo
gutora aho abafite uburenganzira bwo
gutora bahagararirwa na bamwe muri
bo mu gikorwa cy’itora;
(p) “Komisiyo” bivuga Komisiyo
y’Igihugu y’Amatora;
(q) “komite iyobora amatora” bivuga
komite igizwe na perezida w’ibiro
by’itora n’abahuzabikorwa b’ibyumba
by’itora;
(r) “kumenyekanisha ibyavuye mu
itora” bivuga gushyira ahagaragara
ibyavuye mu itora ku rwego itora
riberaho bikozwe n’abayoboye itora
kuri urwo rwego;
(s) “kwiyamamaza” bivuga uburyo
umukandida wigenga, umutwe wa
politiki cyangwa ishyirahamwe
ry’imitwe ya politiki bimenyekanisha,
bikanagaragaza gahunda y’ibikorwa
kugira ngo bishobore gutorwa;
(t) “ubwihugiko” bivuga ahantu
hagenwa mu cyumba cy’itora kugira
ngo hafashe utora gutora mu ibanga;
(u) “uhagarariye umukandida” bivuga
Umunyarwanda wanditse ku ilisiti
y’itora wahawe ububasha
n’umukandida bwo gukurikirana
ibikorwa by’itora mu izina rye;
(v) “umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora”
bivuga umuntu ushinzwe kuyobora no
guhuza ibikorwa by’amatora kuri buri
rwego rwa Komisiyo, ushyirwaho na
Komisiyo;
(w)“umukandida” bivuga umuntu ku giti
cye, umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
byujuje ibisabwa bihiganwa binyuze
mu itora;
(x) “umukorerabushake w’itora”
bivuga umuntu ubishaka kandi
ubifitiye ubushobozi ushyirwaho na
Komisiyo, ugira uruhare mu bikorwa
byo gutegura no kuyobora amatora, nta
gihembo;
(y) “umuseseri” bivuga umuntu ushinzwe
imirimo y’itora mu cyumba cy’itora;
(z) “urwego rwa Komisiyo” bivuga
icyumba cy’itora, ibiro by’itora,
Akarere, Intara cyangwa Umujyi wa
Kigali n’Igihugu amatora aberamo
n’ahandi hagenwa na Komisiyo;
(aa) “utora” bivuga
Umunyarwanda wese ufite
uburenganzira bwo gutora.

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iri tegeko ngenga Iri tegeko ngenga rireba amatora akurikira
Urwego rushinzwe ibijyanye n’amatora (1) Urwego rushinzwe ibijyanye n’amatora ni Komisiyo
articles.text:
(2) Komisiyo ishinzwe gukurikirana
iyubahirizwa ry’amategeko agenga
ibikorwa by’amatora kandi igatanga, igihe
bibaye ngombwa, amabwiriza akenewe
kugira ngo ibikorwa by’amatora bigende
neza hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko
ngenga.
(3) Mu kurangiza inshingano zayo, Komisiyo
ishyiraho abakorerabushake b’amatora.
(4) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
abakorerabushake b’amatora bajyaho
n’ibyo bagomba kuba bujuje.
UMUTWE WA II: IMITEGURIRE
N’IMIGENDEKERE Y’AMATORA
MURI RUSANGE
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ilisiti y’itora
(a) uwambuwe n’inkiko zibifitiye
ububasha uburenganzira bwo gutora
akaba atarahanagurwaho ubwo
busembwa cyangwa ngo ahabwe
imbabazi mu buryo buteganywa
n’amategeko;
(b) Uwahamwe n’icyaha cy’ubwicanyi
buturutse ku bushake;
(c) Uwahamwe n’icyaha cya jenoside
cyangwa ibyaha byibasiye
inyokomuntu;
(d) uwahamwe n’icyaha cyo gusambanya
abana;
(e) uwahamwe n’icyaha cyo gukoresha
imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato;
(f) ufunzwe;
(g) impunzi.
(2) Buri mwaka n’igihe cyose bibaye
ngombwa, Ubushinjacyaha Bukuru
bushyikiriza Komisiyo urutonde
rw’abahamijwe ku buryo budasubirwaho
ibyaha bituma batemererwa
kwiyandikisha ku ilisiti y’itora.

articles.heading: Inshingano yo kwiyandikisha ku ilisiti y’itora
Uwemerewe kwiyandikisha ku ilisiti y’itora n’ibyo agomba kwerekana
Utemerewe kwiyandikisha ku ilisiti y’itora
Ushinzwe kwandika abantu ku ilisiti y’itora n’inshingano ze (1) Umukorerabushake w’itora ni we
articles.text:
ushinzwe kwandika abantu ku ilisiti
y’itora muri buri Mudugudu no muri buri
Ambasade.
(2) Umukorerabushake w’itora ashinzwe ibi
bikurikira:
(a) gukurikirana ko kwiyandikisha ku
ilisiti y’itora bikurikiza amategeko;
(b) kubika ilisiti y’itora no gucunga
umutekano w’ibikoresho
hifashishijwe inzego z’ubuyobozi
bw’aho icyo gikorwa kibera;
(c) gukora raporo y’igikorwa cyo
kwiyandikisha ku ilisiti y’itora;
(d) gukora undi murimo wose ujyanye
n’itora yashingwa na Komisiyo.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uko
ibivugwa mu gika cya (1) n’icya (2)
bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ikosorwa ry’ilisiti y’itora hagati yo gutangaza ilisiti y’agateganyo n’ilisiti ndakuka (1) Komisiyo ikosora amakosa yagaragaye
articles.text:
nyuma y’itangazwa ry’ilisiti y’itora
y’agateganyo.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
bwo gukosora ilisiti y’itora mu gihe kiri
hagati yo gutangaza ilisiti y’itora
y’agateganyo n’ilisiti ndakuka y’itora

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’urutonde rw’abantu bakuwe ku ilisiti y’itora (1) Urutonde rw’abantu bakuwe ku ilisiti
articles.text:
y’itora hashingiwe ku mpamvu ziteganywa
n’ingingo ya 7 rutangazwa na Komisiyo
mbere y’itangazwa ry’ilisiti ndakuka
y’itora.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
gutangaza urutonde rw’abantu bakuwe ku
ilisiti y’itora bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ibikwa ry’ilisiti y’itora n’uwemerewe kuyerekwa (1) Ilisiti y’itora ibikwa mu bubiko bw’amakuru ya Komisiyo. Umukandida
articles.text:
cyangwa undi muntu Komisiyo
ibyemereye yerekwa kopi yayo.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
bwo kubika ilisiti y’itora no kwerekwa
kopi yayo.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’ikibazo cyerekeranye n’iyandikwa ku ilisiti y’itora (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
articles.text:
gutanga ikibazo cyerekeranye
n’iyandikwa ku ilisiti y’itora. Icyakora,
ikibazo cyakirwa gusa iyo gitanzwe mbere
y’itangazwa ry’ilisiti ndakuka.
(2) Ikibazo gitangwa mu nyandiko
ishyikirizwa urwego rwa Komisiyo rw’aho
icyo kibazo cyagaragaye.
(3) Ku rwego rwa Ambasade y’u Rwanda,
ikibazo gishyikirizwa mu nyandiko
umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora.

articles.heading: Uburyo ikibazo cyerekeye ilisiti y’itora gikemuka (1) Urwego rwa Komisiyo rwashyikirijwe ikibazo cyerekeye ilisiti y’itora rufata
articles.text:
icyemezo bitarenze amasaha 48 abarwa
uhereye igihe icyo kibazo cyakiriwe. Kopi
y’icyo cyemezo ihita ihabwa uwo kireba
kandi ilisiti y’itora ihita ikosorwa igihe
bibaye ngombwa, hakorwa irindi
yandikwa ry’inyongera cyangwa
ihanagurwa bitewe n’icyo icyemezo
kivuga.
(2) Iyo uwatanze ikibazo atanyuzwe
n’icyemezo cyafashwe, atakambira
urwego rwa Komisiyo rukurikiraho mu
gihe kitarenze amasaha 24 abarwa
uhereye igihe amenyesherejwe icyo
cyemezo.
(3) Ku rwego rwa Ambasade y’u Rwanda,
iyo uwatanze ikibazo atanyuzwe
n’icyemezo cy’umuhuzabikorwa
w’amatora, ashyikiriza ikibazo cye
Perezida wa Komisiyo mu gihe kitarenze
amasaha 24 abarwa uhereye igihe
amenyesherejwe icyo cyemezo.

articles.heading: Kuregera urukiko icyemezo kijyanye n’iyandikwa cyangwa ikosorwa ry’ilisiti y’itora Icyemezo kijyanye n’iyandikwa cyangwa
articles.text:
ikosorwa ry’ilisiti y’itora cyafashwe ku rwego
rwa nyuma na Komisiyo gishobora kuregerwa
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha. Icyakora, kuba
ikirego cyashyikirijwe urukiko ntibihagarika
imigendekere y’ibikorwa by’itora.
Icyiciro cya 2: Gutanga kandidatire no
kwiyamamaza

articles.heading: Umuntu wemerewe gutorwa Umuntu wemerewe gutorwa aba – (a) yujuje imyaka iteganywa n’amategeko;
Imyanya itorerwa itabangikanywa (1) Uwatowe abujijwe kubangikanya imirimo ibiri muri iyi ikurikira
Igihe cyo gutanga kandidatire
Kutaboneka k’umukandida wiyamamaza ku mwanya utorerwa Iyo nta mukandida ubonetse wiyamamaza ku
articles.text:
mwanya utorerwa, Komisiyo ibitangariza
abaturage bireba, gutanga kandidatire
bikongera gukorwa mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
30 ibarwa uhereye ku munsi byatangarijweho,
itora rigakorwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko ngenga.

articles.heading: Gutangaza kandidatire zemewe (1) Kandidatire zemewe zitangazwa hasigaye nibura iminsi irindwi ngo igikorwa cyo
articles.text:
kwiyamamaza gitangire, uretse igihe
biteganywa ukundi n’iri tegeko ngenga.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
kandidatire zitangazwamo.

articles.heading: Gukuramo kandidatire (1) Uwatanze kandidatire afite uburenganzira bwo kuyikuramo mbere y’uko itora
articles.text:
ritangira.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
gukuramo kandidatire bikorwa.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo kwiyamamaza n’uko bikorwa (1) Umukandida afite uburenganzira bwo kwiyamamaza mu gihe cyagenwe
articles.text:
n’inzego zibifitiye ububasha.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uko
ibikorwa byo kwiyamamaza bigenda kuri
buri cyiciro cy’itora.

articles.heading: Imigendekere y’inama cyangwa amakoraniro mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza Mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza, inama cyangwa
articles.text:
amakoraniro byo kwiyamamaza biba mu
bwisanzure, hubahirizwa ituze rusange rya
rubanda, amategeko n’amabwiriza.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’umukandida bwo gukoresha inyandiko zimanikwa n’ibindi bimwamamaza Umukandida afite uburenganzira bwo
articles.text:
gukoresha inyandiko zimanikwa n’ibindi
bimwamamaza bitanyuranyije n’amategeko,
uretse igihe biteganywa ukundi n’iri tegeko
ngenga.

articles.heading: Ibibujijwe mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza cyangwa kwamamaza Umuntu abujijwe gukora ibikurikira mu gihe
Ibibujijwe umukandida ku munsi ubanziriza uw’itora no ku munsi w’itora Ku munsi ubanziriza uw’itora no ku munsi
articles.text:
w’itora, uretse igihe biteganywa ukundi,
umukandida abujijwe –
(a) gukora igikorwa cyose kijyanye no
kwiyamamaza;
(b) no kuba hafi y’ibiro by’itora keretse
iyo aje gutora n’igihe cyo kubarura
amajwi.
Icyiciro cya 3: Imitunganyirize y’ibikorwa
by’itora
Akiciro ka mbere: Ibiro by’itora
n’abashinzwe imirimo y’itora ku biro
by’itora

articles.heading: Igenwa ry’ibiro by’itora n’aho bishyirwa (1) Ibiro by’itora bishyirwa mu nyubako za Leta, izikorerwamo imirimo ya Leta
articles.text:
cyangwa ahandi hagenwa na Komisiyo.
(2) Mu itora rya Perezida wa Repubulika,
iry’abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko
batorwa mu buryo butaziguye na
referandumu, ibiro by’itora hanze
y’Igihugu bishyirwa ahantu hose hari
Ambasade y’u Rwanda. Ambasaderi
ashobora gushyira ibiro by’itora ahandi
hantu mu ifasi y’Ambasade amaze
kubihererwa uruhushya na Komisiyo.
(3) Komisiyo igena ahashyirwa ibiro by’itora,
umubare wabyo, ibyumba bigize buri biro
by’itora hasigaye nibura iminsi 15 ngo
itora rikorwe.

articles.heading: Abashinzwe kuyobora amatora ku biro by’itora no mu byumba bigize ibiro by’itora (1) Perezida w’ibiro by’itora ni we uhuza
articles.text:
ibikorwa by’amatora ku biro by’itora.
(2) Umuhuzabikorwa w’icyumba cy’itora
n’abaseseri ni bo bashinzwe imirimo
y’itora mu cyumba cy’itora.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena
inshingano za Perezida w’ibiro by’itora,
iz’umuhuzabikorwa w’icyumba cy’itora
n’iz’abaseseri.

articles.heading: Irahira ry’abayobora amatora mu biro by’itora Mbere yo gutangira imirimo y’itora, abagize ibiro by’itora barahirira imbere y’abaturage
articles.text:
bahari indahiro y’abayobozi iteganywa
n’Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.

articles.heading: Uguhagararirwa k’umukandida mu cyumba cy’itora no ku biro by’itora
Ibikorwa by’itora uhagarariye umukandida yemerewe gukurikirana (1) Uhagarariye umukandida yemerewe
articles.text:
gukurikirana ibikorwa by’itora
bitandukanye uretse ibikorerwa mu
bwihugiko.
(2) Ibyo uhagarariye umukandida abonye
binyuranyije n’amategeko, abikorera
inyandiko mvugo ashyiraho umukono,
kopi imwe igashyikirizwa
umuhuzabikorwa w’icyumba cy’itora, indi
igashyikirizwa umukandida ahagarariye.
(3) Umuhuzabikorwa w’icyumba cy’itora
yandika mu nyandiko mvugo ibyagenzuwe
yagejejweho hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu
gika cya (2). Ibyagenzuwe byanditswe
muri ubwo buryo ni byo byonyine
byitabwaho mu guherekeza ikibazo
gishobora kuvuka nyuma gikomotse ku
mpaka zerekeye itora.

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’indorerezi z’itora (1) Indorerezi z’itora zemerwa na Komisiyo ishingiye ku busabe bwazo
articles.text:
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena igihe cyo
kwakira ubusabe n’icyo kwemera
indorerezi z’itora.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’indorerezi y’itora n’ubw’uhagarariye umukandida Indorerezi y’itora n’uhagarariye umukandida
Ibigomba kubahirizwa n’indorerezi y’itora n’uhagarariye umukandida (1) Indorerezi y’itora n’uhagarariye
articles.text:
umukandida bubahiriza ibi bikurikira:
(a) kwirinda igikorwa cyose
cyabangamira imigendekere myiza
y’itora;
(b) kwirinda kubogama mu bikorwa
by’itora;
(c) gukurikiza ibiteganywa n’amategeko
agenga Igihugu muri rusange
n’amategeko yerekeye amatora
by’umwihariko;
(d) kubaha umuco w’Igihugu;
(e) kwirinda gutanga amabwiriza ku
bayobora itora;
(f) gukorera aho yemerewe gukorera mu
Gihugu;
(g) kubaha abayobora itora mu nzego
zose;
(h) kwirinda gutangaza ibyavuye mu itora
mu gihe urwego rubishinzwe
rutarabikora.
(2) By’umwihariko indorerezi y’itora ikora
raporo ishingiye ku byagaragaye mu itora,
ikayigeza kuri Komisiyo mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 60 itora rirangiye.
Akiciro ka 3: Agasanduku n’impapuro
by’itora

articles.heading: Itegurwa n’imikoreshereze y’agasanduku k’itora (1) Mbere y’uko itora ritangira, agasanduku k’itora gafite umwenge umwe gusa wo
articles.text:
kunyuzamo urupapuro rw’itora, kagomba
kuba karimo ubusa kandi abayobora
amatora bakakereka abaturage,
abahagarariye abakandida n’indorerezi
z’itora iyo bahari gafunguye. Mbere yo
gutangira itora, karafungwa kakongera
gufungurwa ibarura ry’amajwi ritangiye.
Nyuma yo kubarura amajwi kongera
gufungwa karimo impapuro z’itora
zatoreweho.
(2) Agasanduku k’itora gashyirwa aho
umuntu wese uri mu cyumba cy’itora
ashobora kukabona.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
agasanduku k’itora gafungwa.

articles.heading: Imiterere y’urupapuro rw’itora n’ibarura ry’impapuro zikoreshwa mu cyumba cy’itora (1) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena imiterere
articles.text:
n’imikoreshereze y’urupapuro rw’itora.
(2) Mbere y’uko itora ritangira, abashinzwe
kuyobora amatora mu cyumba cy’itora
babara impapuro z’itora bahawe, uwo
mubare bakawushyira mu nyandiko
mvugo.
Akiciro ka 4: Igihe itora rimara n’uko
rikorwa

articles.heading: Igihe itora rimara (1) Itora rimara umunsi umwe kuri buri cyiciro cy’itora. Icyakora iyo habaye
articles.text:
impamvu ituma risubikwa, Komisiyo
igena ukundi byagenda.
(2) Mu itora ritaziguye, itora ritangira saa
moya z’amanywa rikarangira saa cyenda
z’amanywa. Mu itora riziguye, isaha itora
ritangirira n’igihe rirangirizwa igenwa
n’amabwiriza ya Komisiyo.
(3) Igihe hari impamvu ituma itora
ridatangirira igihe cyangwa ridasorezwa
igihe, komite iyobora amatora ishobora
guhindura isaha yo gutangira no kurangiza
itora nyuma yo kubimenyesha no kugisha
inama Perezida wa Komisiyo.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gutora (1) Gutora bikorwa mu ibanga, uretse igihe biteganywa ukundi n’iri tegeko ngenga
articles.text:
(2) Gutora bikorwa mu mucyo no mu
bwisanzure, ntawe ushobora gushyirwaho
igitugu cyangwa gukoreshwaho ubundi
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose kugira ngo
ahindure uko yari gutora.
(3) Gutora bishobora gukorwa mu buryo
butaziguye cyangwa buziguye bitewe
n’imiterere ya buri tora.
(4) Mu gutora hakoreshwa urupapuro
rw’itora, kujya ku murongo inyuma
y’umukandida utora yihitiyemo cyangwa
ubundi buryo bwagenwa na Komisiyo.
(5) Mu itora rikoreshwamo urupapuro
rw’itora, utora ashobora gutera igikumwe
cyangwa agakoresha ikaramu.
(6) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry’ibiteganywa muri iyi
ngingo.

articles.heading: Umubare wa ngombwa w’abagize inteko itora kugira ngo itora mu buryo buziguye ritangire (1) Itora mu buryo buziguye ritangira ari uko
articles.text:
inteko itora yujuje nibura ubwiganze
burunduye bw’abayigize.
(2) Iyo ubwiganze burunduye butabonetse
uwo munsi, itora rihita risubikwa
rikazongera kuba mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi irindwi. Iyo ubwiganze burunduye
butabonetse ku nshuro ya kabiri, itora
rikorwa n’abaje.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena umunsi
itora riteganywa mu gika cya (2)
risubukurirwaho.

articles.heading: Umutuzo mu gikorwa cy’itora Itora rikorwa mu mutuzo. Umuntu ntiyemerewe kwinjira mu cyumba cy’itora
articles.text:
afite intwaro, uretse ushinzwe umutekano
abisabwe na Perezida w’ibiro by’itora kugira
ngo agarure ituze igihe umutekano
wahungabanye.

articles.heading: Gutora inshuro imwe no gutorera mu bwihugiko Mu itora, umuntu atora inshuro imwe. Gutora bikorerwa mu bwihugiko uretse igihe
articles.text: biteganyijwe ukundi n’iri tegeko ngenga.

articles.heading: Ushyira umukono ku nyandiko mvugo z’ibikorwa by’itora mu cyumba cy’itora
Ikemurwa ry’ikibazo kigaragaye mu cyumba cy’itora cyangwa ku biro by’itora
Uwemerewe gutorera aho atiyandikishirije
Isubikwa ry’itora iyo ibikoresho by’itora bishize Iyo bimwe mu bikoresho by’itora bishize abatora bagihari, ibikorwa by’itora
articles.text:
byakorwaga bihita bisubikwa bikamenyeshwa
abahari. Byongera gusubukurwa iyo ibyo
bikoresho by’itora bibonetse kandi
bikandikwa mu nyandiko mvugo.

articles.heading: Ibimenyetso bigaragaza uwatoye (1) Nyuma yo gutora no gushyira urupapuro mu gasanduku k’itora uwatoye ahabwa
articles.text:
ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko yatoye.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena
ibimenyetso bigaragaza uwatoye n’uburyo
bikoreshwa.
Akiciro ka 5: Ibarura n’ikusanya
by’amajwi

articles.heading: Igihe igikorwa cyo kubarura amajwi gitangirira n’abashinzwe kubarura amajwi (1) Igikorwa cy’ibarura ry’amajwi gitangira
articles.text:
ako kanya nyuma yo kurangiza itora kandi
kikabera muri buri cyumba cy’itora.
(2) Ibikorwa by’ibarura bikorwa n’abaseseri
mu ruhame, imbere y’abaturage,
indorerezi z’itora, n’abakandida cyangwa
abahagarariye abakandida, iyo bahari.

articles.heading: Uko ibikorwa by’ibarura ry’amajwi bikurikirana (1) Ibikorwa by’ibarura ry’amajwi bikurikirana ku buryo bukurikira
articles.text:
(a) kwemeza umubare w’abatoye bari ku
ilisiti y’itora no kuwutangaza;
(b) gufungura agasanduku k’itora mu
ruhame;
(c) kubarura impapuro zatoreweho zirimo
no gutangaza umubare wazo;
(d) umwe mu baseseri ahereza mugenzi
we urupapuro rw’itora rurambuye na
we akarusoma mu ijwi riranguruye;
(e) umuseseri wa gatatu mu baseseri
ashyira ijwi riri kuri urwo rupapuro
rw’itora ku rundi rupapuro
rwabigenewe rubarurirwaho amajwi
rumanikwa ahagaragarira buri wese
uhari cyangwa ubundi buryo
bwateganyijwe na Komisiyo;
(f) iyo impapuro zose z’itora zimaze
gusomwa, habarurwa amajwi buri
mukandida cyangwa ilisiti
y’abakandida byabonye hashingiwe ku
mpapuro zatoreweho neza,
hakanabarurwa impapuro
z’impfabusa, iyo zihari;
(g) abaseseri bemeza ibyagaragajwe ku
mpapuro zabaruriweho amajwi
bazishyiraho umukono kandi imikono
y’ababaruye amajwi igomba
kubanzirizwa n’amazina yose na
nomero y’ikarita ndangamuntu;
(h) abakandida cyangwa ababahagarariye
bahari bashobora na bo gushyira
umukono ku mpapuro z’ibarura
ry’amajwi, ariko iyo batazishyizeho
umukono ntibitesha agaciro amajwi
yabaruwe;
(i) kumenyekanisha ibyavuye mu ibarura
bikorwa ako kanya ibarura rirangiye;
(j) abashinzwe kuyobora itora mu cyumba
cy’itora begeranya ibyavuye mu
ibarura ry’amajwi;
(k) umuhuzabikorwa w’icyumba cy’itora
n’abaseseri bakora nta kubisubika,
inyandiko mvugo muri kopi ebyiri
z’ibyo bikorwa ku mpapuro
zabigenewe, ikubiyemo ibi bikurikira:
(i) isaha y’itangizwa n’irangizwa
by’itora, uko ibyangombwa
bisabwa n’iri tegeko ngenga
byubahirijwe n’ibibazo byagiye
bivuka mu bikorwa by’itora, iyo
bihari;
(ii) umukono w’abayobora itora mu
cyumba cy’itora, uw’abakandida
cyangwa ababahagarariye, iyo
bahari;
(iii)iyo abakandida cyangwa
abahagarariye abakandida
badashyize umukono ku nyandiko
mvugo ntibiyibuza kwemerwa.
(l) abahagarariye abakandida bafite
uburenganzira bwo kugenzura
ibikorwa byose by’ibarura ry’amajwi
ndetse no gusaba ko mu nyandiko
mvugo handikwamo ibyo bagenzuye,
cyangwa ibyo batemeranyijweho;
(m) umuhuzabikorwa w’icyumba cy’itora
ategura inyandiko mvugo muri kopi
ebyiri, imwe ishyirwa mu ibahasha
akayifunga igashyirwa mu gasanduku
k’itora k’icyumba cy’itora hamwe
n’impapuro zatoreweho neza,
izitatoreweho n’iz’impfabusa,
akabishyikiriza Perezida w’ibiro
by’itora, naho indi kopi igashyikirizwa
Perezida w’ibiro by’itora;
(n) Perezida w’ibiro by’itora ahuriza
hamwe ibyavuye mu itora yifashishije
inyandiko mvugo zavuye mu byumba
by’itora akabikorera inyandiko mvugo,
akayishyira mu ibahasha, akayifunga,
akayiteraho kashe mu ruhame iyo
nyandiko mvugo ikohererezwa
umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora ku rwego
rw’Akarere abinyujije ku
muhuzabikorwa w’amatora ku rwego
rw’Umurenge kandi iyo nyandiko
mvugo igomba kuba ikubiyemo ibi
bikurikira:
(i) umubare w’abari ku ilisiti
y’itora bemerewe gutora;
(ii) umubare w’abatoye;
(iii) umubare w’abatoye mu
cyumba cy’itora batari ku ilisiti
y’itora y’icyo cyumba cy’itora;
(iv) umubare w’impapuro z’itora
bahawe;
(v) umubare w’impapuro z’itora
zatoreweho neza
n’iz’impfabusa;
(vi) umubare w’impapuro
z’ibirego, iyo bihari;
(vii) umubare w’impapuro
zabaruriweho amajwi;
(viii) umubare w’impapuro z’itora
zitakoreshejwe.
(2) Iyo hakozwe amatora arenze rimwe ku
munsi umwe, amabwiriza ya Komisiyo
agena itora riherwaho mu kubarura
amajwi.

articles.heading: Ibiranga impfabusa (1) Urupapuro rw’itora ruba impfabusa iyo – (a) rudahuje n’ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko
Uburyo ibyavuye mu itora bihurizwa hamwe (1) Kuri buri rwego umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora ahuriza hamwe ibyavuye mu
articles.text:
itora akabimenyesha indorerezi z’itora,
abahagarariye abakandida, abanyamakuru
n’abaturage iyo bahari.
(2) Guhuriza hamwe ibyavuye mu itora ku
nzego z’imitegekere y’Igihugu
zitandukanye bikorwa hakurikijwe
amabwiriza ya Komisiyo.
(3) Inyandiko ihurizwaho ibyavuye mu itora,
imanikwa aho icyo gikorwa cyabereye.
Imiterere y’iyo nyandiko n’aho imanikwa
bigenwa n’amabwiriza ya Komisiyo.
(4) Perezida wa Komisiyo ni we uhuriza
hamwe ku rwego rw’Igihugu ibyavuye mu
itora, hashingiwe ku nyandiko
zahurijweho amajwi.

articles.heading: Ikusanywa n’ibikwa by’impapuro z’itora Hashingiwe ku mabwiriza ya Komisiyo, impapuro z’itora zakoreshejwe mu gihe
articles.text:
cy’itora, zikusanyirizwa hamwe kandi
zikabikwa n’umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora ku
rwego rw’Akarere kugeza igihe ibyavuye mu
itora bitangarijwe burundu.

articles.heading: Gutsinda itora k’umukandida umwe rukumbi (1) Mu gihe hari umukandida umwe rukumbi mu itora, uwo mukandida atsinda itora ari
articles.text:
uko atowe ku bwiganze burunduye
bw’amajwi y’abatoye neza.
(2) Igihe umukandida atatowe, hakoreshwa
irindi tora mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 90
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi ibyavuye mu
itora bitangarijweho, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko ngenga.
(3) Iyo mu rindi tora riteganywa mu gika cya
(2), umukandida yongeye kuba umwe
rukumbi, atsinda itora ku majwi yabonye
uko angana kose.

articles.heading: Itangira rya manda ku batowe Manda y’abatowe ku nzego zose ziteganywa n’iri tegeko ngenga basabwa kurahira, itangira
articles.text:
ku munsi barahiriyeho indahiro iteganyijwe
n’Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.

articles.heading: Umukandida watowe atari yujuje ibisabwa Nyuma yo gutangaza burundu ibyavuye mu itora, igihe cyose bigaragaye ko umukandida
articles.text:
watanze kandidatire ikemerwa akanatorwa
atari yujuje ibisabwa, itorwa rye riseswa
n’urukiko rubifitiye ububasha bisabwe
n’ubifitemo inyungu wese. Icyakora, ibikorwa
yakoze bijyanye n’inshingano yatorewe
bigumana agaciro kabyo.
(b) kigizwe n’urwunge rw’amabara agize
ibendera ry’Igihugu;
(c) cyakurura amacakubiri;
(d) cyatera urujijo;
(e) cyangwa cyatoranyijwe n’undi
mukandida.
(2) Iyo hari abakandida benshi, imitwe ya
politiki cyangwa amashyiramwe y’imitwe
ya politiki bahisemo inyuguti imwe
cyangwa ikimenyetso kimwe, Komisiyo
ifata icyemezo ndakuka ko gikoreshwa
n’umutwe wa politiki, ishyirahamwe
ry’imitwe ya politiki cyangwa
umukandida wigenga watanze kandidatire
mbere.

articles.heading: Igenwa ry’umunsi w’itora n’igihe cyo kwiyamamaza
Ikimenyetso n’inyuguti bibujijwe gukoreshwa mu bikorwa by’amatora
Igihe cyo kuzuza idosiye ituzuye Mbere yo gutangaza ilisiti ndakuka y’abakandida, umukandida utemerewe na
articles.text:
Komisiyo kubera idosiye ituzuye amenyeshwa
mu nyandiko ibibura mu idosiye ye, agahabwa
umwanya wo kubyuzuza. Ibyo bikorwa mu
gihe cy’iminsi itanu y’akazi nyuma yo
gutangaza ilisiti y’agateganyo y’abakandida
na mbere yo gutangaza ilisiti ndakuka.

articles.heading: Imenyesha ry’ahakorerwa igikorwa cyo kwiyamamaza Umukandida cyangwa uhagarariye umukandida amenyesha mu nyandiko
articles.text:
Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere yifuza ko kazaberamo
igikorwa cyo kwiyamamaza igihe n’aho icyo
gikorwa kizabera, nibura amasaha 24 mbere
y’uko icyo gikorwa kiba, akagenera kopi
umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora ku rwego
rw’Akarere. Iyo nyandiko itangwa mu masaha
y’akazi igatangirwa icyemezo cy’iyakira.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gukemura impaka iyo habayeho impurirane y’ibikorwa byo kwiyamamaza (1) Mu itora ritaziguye, nta bikorwa byo
articles.text:
kwiyamamaza birenze kimwe bishobora
kubera icya rimwe mu Kagari ko mu
murenge ugize Umujyi wa Kigali cyangwa
mu Murenge ugize Akarere ko mu Ntara.
(2) Iyo hamenyekanishijwe ibikorwa birenze
kimwe, uwamenyekanishije mbere ni we
wemererwa. Icyakora, iyo uwamenyesheje
(2) Ubuyobozi bw’igitangazamakuru
busubiza, mu nyandiko, umukandida
bumugaragariza itariki n’igihe yemerewe
kwiyamamarizaho, bugaha kopi
Komisiyo.
(3) Inyandiko isubiza umukandida itangwa
hasigaye nibura iminsi ibiri mbere y’uko
icyo gikorwa cyo kwiyamamaza gitangira.
Umukandida ashyira umukono kuri iyo
nyandiko yemeza ko yayakiriye.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwemewe gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza
Kwiyamamaza mu gitangazamakuru cya Leta n’uko bisabwa
Ibyemezo bifatirwa umukandida wigenga utubahiriza amategeko mu gikorwa cyo kwiyamamaza (1) Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’andi
articles.text:
mategeko, umukandida wigenga
ugaragayeho kutubahiriza amategeko mu
gihe cyo kwiyamamaza, atumizwa na
Komisiyo kugira ngo yihanangirizwe bwa
mbere ku mugaragaro mu magambo.
(2) Iyo umukandida wigenga, nyuma yo
kwihanangirizwa, atikosoye, Komisiyo
imwihanangiriza bwa nyuma mu nyandiko
imugaragariza ikosa yakoze n’ingingo
z’amategeko zitubahirijwe.
(3) Iyo umukandida wigenga akomeje
kutubahiriza ibiteganywa n’amategeko,
Komisiyo imwandikira imumenyesha ko
kandidatire ye yavanwe mu bakandida
bemerewe kwiyamamaza.
(4) Umukandida wigenga wavanwe mu
bakandida afite uburenganzira bwo
kuregera icyemezo cya Komisiyo mu
rukiko rubifiye ububasha mu gihe
kitarenze amasaha 24 abarwa uhereye
igihe amenyesherejwe ko kandidatire ye
yavanwe mu bakandida bemerewe
kwiyamamaza. Icyakora, gutanga ikirego
ntibibuza igikorwa cy’itora gukomeza.

articles.heading: Ibyemezo bifatirwa umutwe wa politiki cyangwa ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki bitubahiriza
articles.text:
amategeko mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza
(1) Iyo umukandida uri ku ilisiti yatanzwe
n’umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
agaragaweho kutubahiriza amategeko mu
gihe cyo kwiyamamaza, Komisiyo
ihamagaza ikanihanangiriza ku
mugaragaro, mu magambo, uwo mutwe
wa politiki cyangwa iryo shyirahamwe
ry’imitwe ya politiki.
(2) Iyo umukandida wagaragaweho
kutubahiriza amategeko mu kwiyamamaza
atikosoye, Komisiyo yandikira umutwe wa
politiki cyangwa ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe
ya politiki abarizwamo ibihanangiriza bwa
nyuma.
(3) Iyo kutubahiriza amategeko bikomeje
Komisiyo isaba umutwe wa politiki
cyangwa ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya
politiki kuvana ku ilisiti uwo mukandida,
mu gihe kitarenze amasaha 12 nyuma yo
kugaragarizwa mu nyandiko irindi kosa
yakoze.
(4) Iyo umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
ritabikoze, Komisiyo ifata icyemezo cyo
kumuvana ku ilisiti y’abakandida mu gihe
kitarenze amasaha 24 abarwa kuva
umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
bisabwe kumuvana ku ilisiti,
bikamenyeshwa umutwe wa politiki
cyangwa ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya
politiki bireba, urwego rufite mu
nshingano kwandika imitwe ya politiki,
Sena, Urukiko rw’Ikirenga n’Ihuriro
ry’Igihugu Nyunguranabitekerezo
ry’Imitwe ya Politiki.
(5) Umukandida wavanwe ku ilisiti
y’abakandida afite uburenganzira bwo
kuregera icyemezo cya Komisiyo mu
rukiko rubifiye ububasha, mu gihe
kitarenze amasaha 24 nyuma yo kuvanwa
ku ilisiti y’abakandida. Icyakora, gutanga
ikirego ntibibuza igikorwa cy’itora
gukomeza.
(6) Umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
byagaragaweho kutubahiriza amategeko
mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza bikurikiranwa
hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.

articles.heading: Gutangaza ibyavuye mu itora n’igihe bikorerwa (1) Komisiyo itangaza ibyavuye mu itora – (a) by’agateganyo, mu gihe kitarenze
articles.text:
iminsi itanu itora rirangiye;
(b) na burundu, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
irindwi nyuma yo gutangaza ibyavuye
mu itora by’agateganyo.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
gutangaza ibyavuye mu itora bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ikirego kijyanye n’itangwa rya kandidatire n’ikijyanye n’itora rya Perezida wa Repubulika cyangwa
articles.text:
n’iry’Abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko
(1) Umunyarwanda ubifitemo inyungu
cyangwa umukandida bafite
uburenganzira bwo gushyikiriza urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha ikirego kijyanye
n’itangwa rya kandidatire cyangwa n’itora
rya Perezida wa Repubulika cyangwa
n’iry’Abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko.
(2) Ushaka gutanga ikirego kivugwa mu gika
cya (1) abikora mu masaha 48 akurikira
umunsi Komisiyo itangarijeho
by’agateganyo ilisiti y’abakandida
cyangwa ibyavuye mu itora.
(3) Nta kirego gishobora kubuza ibikorwa
by’itora gukomeza uretse ikijyanye no
gutangaza burundu ibyavuye mu itora.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’ibyavuye mu itora igihe habayeho gukosora Iyo urukiko rutegetse ko ibyavuye mu itora
articles.text:
bikosorwa, Komisiyo itangaza burundu
ibyavuye mu itora ishingiye ku cyemezo
cy’urukiko.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ingingo zihariye ku itora rya
Perezida wa Repubulika
Akiciro ka mbere: Ingingo zihariye ku itora
rya Perezida wa Repubulika

articles.heading: Itangwa rya kandidatire ku mwanya wa Perezida wa Repubulika (1) Gutanga kandidatire ku mwanya wa
articles.text:
Perezida wa Repubulika bikorwa
n’umuntu ku giti cye, mu nyandiko kandi
igashyikirizwa Komisiyo ikayitangira
icyemezo cy’iyakira.
(2) Inyandiko umukandida asabwa azitanga
muri kopi ebyiri, imwe igasigara muri
Komisiyo, indi Komisiyo ikayiteramo
kashe kuri buri rupapuro ikayimusubiza.
(3) Gutanga kandidatire ku mwanya wa
Perezida wa Repubulika bikorwa hasigaye
nibura iminsi 45 ngo itora ribe.

articles.heading: Ibigomba kugaragara mu idosiye y’utanga kandidatire ku mwanya wa Perezida wa Repubulika (1) Idosiye y’umuntu utanga kandidatire ku
articles.text:
mwanya wa Perezida wa Repubulika
igomba kuba ikubiyemo ibi bikurikira:
(a) inyandiko itanga kandidatire
igaragaza–
(i) amazina ye yose ahwanye n’ari ku
ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(ii) kandi ko umukandida yatanzwe
n’umutwe wa politiki wemewe
n’amategeko cyangwa
n’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya
politiki ryashinzwe mu buryo
bukurikije amategeko, cyangwa ko
ari umukandida wigenga cyangwa
umukandida ushyigikiwe n’imitwe
ya politiki myinshi.
(b) umwirondoro ugaragaza –
(i) umurimo akora;
(ii) aho aba;
(iii)n’imirimo yakoze.
(c) kopi y’ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(d) amafoto abiri magufi y’amabara;
(e) inyandiko ye yemeza ko nta bundi
bwenegihugu afite cyangwa igaragaza
ko yaretse ubundi bwenegihugu yari
afite;
(f) icyemezo cy’amavuko cyatanzwe
n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha;
(g) icyemezo cy’imyitwarire myiza
gitangwa n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha;
(h) icyemezo kigaragaza ko umuntu
yakatiwe cyangwa atakatiwe n’inkiko
kitarengeje igihe, gitangwa n’urwego
rubifitiye ububasha;
(i) icyemezo gitanzwe n’umutwe wa
politiki cyangwa n’ishyirahamwe
ry’imitwe ya politiki kigaragaza ko
byamutanzeho umukandida mu itora
rya Perezida wa Repubulika;
(j) icyemezo cy’uko yagaragaje
umutungo we igihe umukandida ari mu
bagomba kuwumenyekanisha;
(k) icyemezo cya muganga wemewe;
(l) ikimenyetso kimuranga gishyirwa ku
rupapuro rw’itora;
(m)inyandiko ye yashyizeho umukono
cyangwa igikumwe yemeza ko
inyandiko yasabwe kandi yatanze ari
ukuri.
(2) Ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)(i) bireba
abakandida batanzwe n’imitwe ya politiki
cyangwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya
politiki.

articles.heading: Ibindi biherekeza by’umwihariko kandidatire ku mukandida wigenga (1) Umukandida wigenga atanga ilisiti
articles.text:
y’abantu bemerewe gutora ishyigikira
kandidatire ye kandi iriho abemerewe
gutora nibura 600 biyandikishije ku ilisiti
y’itora, igaragaza nibura abantu 12 muri
buri Karere bari ku ilisiti y’itora y’Akarere
batuyemo.
(2) Urutonde rw’abantu bashyigikiye
umukandida wigenga rugaragaza kuri buri
muntu ibi bikurikira:
(a) amazina ye yose ahwanye n’ari ku
ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(b) inomero y’ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(c) aho atuye;
(d) aho yanditswe ku ilisiti y’itora;
(e) umukono cyangwa igikumwe bye.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena igihe
n’uburyo umukandida wigenga ategura
ilisiti y’abantu bemerewe gutora
bashyigikiye kandidatire ye.
Akiciro ka 2: Itora rya Perezida wa
Repubulika

articles.heading: Ifasi y’itora mu itora rya Perezida wa Repubulika Ifasi y’itora mu itora rya Perezida wa Repubulika ni Igihugu cyose. Icyakora,
articles.text:
Abanyarwanda bari mu mahanga bemerewe
gutorera aho baba mu buryo buteganywa n’iri
tegeko ngenga.

articles.heading: Uburyo itora rya Perezida wa Repubulika rikorwa (1) Perezida wa Repubulika atorwa mu buryo butaziguye kandi mu ibanga
articles.text:
(2) Mu gutora Perezida wa Repubulika
hatorwa umukandida umwe kandi mu
cyiciro kimwe cy’itora.
(3) Umukandida wa mbere warushije abandi
amajwi ni we uba Perezida wa Repubulika.
Iyo aba mbere banganyije amajwi, itora
risubirwamo kuri abo bakandida gusa mu
gihe kitarenze iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi ibyavuye mu itora ryabanje
byatangarijweho burundu.

Akiciro ka mbere: Itangwa rya kandidatire

articles.heading: Uburyo kandidatire itangwa (1) Umuntu ushaka kwiyamamariza umwanya w’ubudepite atanga kandidatire ku giti cye
articles.text:
ku mwanya umwe gusa mu itora
ry’Abadepite.
(2) Umuntu ntiyemerewe gutanga kandidatire
ye mu cyiciro cy’itora riziguye
n’iritaziguye icyarimwe.
(3) Kandidatire ishyikirizwa Komisiyo,
hasigaye nibura iminsi 45 ngo itariki
y’itora igere.
(4) Komisiyo itanga icyemezo cy’iyakira.
Icyakora, guhabwa icyo cyemezo
ntibivuga ko kandidatire yatanzwe
yemewe.
(5) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
bwo gutanga no kwakira kandidatire.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’ilisiti y’abakandida b’imitwe ya politiki cyangwa ab’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
articles.text:
(1) Umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
bitanga ilisiti ndakuka y’abakandida.
(2) Ilisiti ndakuka ntirenza amazina
y’abakandida 80. Nibura 30%
by’abakandida bari ku ilisiti ndakuka
bagomba kuba ari abagore.
(3) Uhagarariye umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki,
ashyikiriza Komisiyo ilisiti y’abakandida
n’amadosiye yabo hamwe n’icyemezo
cy’uko yahawe ububasha bwo
guhagararira umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki. Iyo
atabonetse, bishobora gukorwa n’undi
muntu yabihereye ububasha.
(4) Ilisiti y’abakandida b’imitwe ya politiki
cyangwa ab’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya
politiki iherekezwa na –
(a) Inyandiko mvugo iriho amazina
n’imikono by’abagize urwego rukuru
rw’umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
bemeje iyo lisiti mu buryo bukurikije
amategeko;
(b) n’ikimenyetso cy’umutwe wa politiki
cyangwa icy’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe
ya politiki gishyirwa ku rupapuro
rw’itora.

articles.heading: Ibigomba kugaragara mu madosiye y’abakandida b’imitwe ya politiki cyangwa ab’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya
Itangwa rya kandidatire ku mukandida wigenga n’ibyo asabwa (1) Kandidatire y’umukandida wigenga ifatwa
articles.text:
nk’ilisiti ndakuka y’umuntu ku giti cye.
(2) Uwifuza kuba umukandida wigenga mu
cyiciro cy’Abadepite batorwa mu buryo
butaziguye ashyikiriza Komisiyo
kandidatire ye igaragaza ibi bikurikira:
(a) inyandiko itanga kandidatire
igaragaza–
(i) amazina ye yose ahwanye n’ari
ku ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(ii) n’icyiciro yiyamamarizamo.
(b) umwirondoro ugaragaza –
(i) umurimo akora;
(ii) aho yavukiye;
(iii) itariki y’amavuko ye;
(iv) n’aho aba.
(c) kopi y’ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(d) amafoto ye abiri magufi y’amabara;
(e) icyemezo cy’amavuko gitangwa
n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha;
(f) icyemezo cy’imyitwarire myiza
gitangwa n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha;
(g) icyemezo kigaragaza ko umuntu
yakatiwe cyangwa atakatiwe n’inkiko
kitarengeje igihe, gitangwa n’urwego
rubifitiye ububasha;
(h) icyemezo cya muganga wemewe;
(i) ilisiti y’abantu bemerewe gutora
ishyigikiye kandidatire ye kandi iriho
abemerewe gutora nibura 600
biyandikishije ku ilisiti y’itora,
igaragaza nibura abantu 12 muri buri
Karere bari ku ilisiti y’itora y’Akarere
batuyemo;
(j) ikimenyetso kimuranga gishyirwa ku
rupapuro rw’itora;
(k) inyandiko ye yashyizeho umukono
cyangwa igikumwe yemeza ko
inyandiko yasabwe kandi yatanze ari
ukuri.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena igihe
n’uburyo umukandida wigenga ategura
ilisiti y’abantu bashyigikiye kandidatire
ye.

Itora ry’Abadepite bahagararira urubyiruko
Itora ry’Umudepite uhagararira abantu bafite ubumuga (1) Umudepite umwe uhagararira abantu bafite ubumuga atorwa mu ibanga n’Inama
articles.text:
y’Igihugu y’Abantu bafite ubumuga.
(2) Iteka rya Perezida rigena abagize inteko
itora.
(3) Umukandida wabonye amajwi menshi
kurusha abandi ni we uba watowe.
(4) Iyo abakandida ba mbere banganyije
amajwi, itora risubirwamo kuri abo
bakandida gusa, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
itatu ibarwa uhereye ku munsi ibyavuye
mu itora rya mbere byatangarijweho.
(5) Iyo iryo tora ridakemuye ikibazo ariko
umubare w’abanganyije amajwi
wagabanutse, hakoreshwa irindi tora
hagati y’abanganyije amajwi.
(6) Iyo abo bakandida bongeye kunganya
amajwi ku nshuro ya gatatu, hakoreshwa
tombora kugira ngo hamenyekane
uwegukanye uwo mwanya.
(7) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
gusubiramo itora no gukora tombora
bikorwa.

articles.heading: Isimburwa ry’Umudepite uri ku ilisiti y’umutwe wa politiki cyangwa iy’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
articles.text:
(1) Iyo Umudepite avuye mu murimo we,
asimburwa hakurikijwe uko abakandida
bakurikirana ku ilisiti, umwanya we
uhabwa ukurikiyeho ku ilisiti yatoreweho
akarangiza igihe cya manda gisigaye iyo
kirengeje umwaka umwe.
(2) Icyakora, iyo hari impamvu zituma
ibikubiye mu gika cya (1) bitubahirizwa,
umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
ryandikira Komisiyo risobanura iyo
mpamvu mu gihe kitarenze iminsi itanu
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi uwo Mudepite
yaviriye mu murimo.
(3) Iyo Umudepite watorewe ku ilisiti
y’umutwe wa politiki cyangwa
iy’ishyirahamwe ry’imitwe ya politiki
avuye mu murimo we w’ubudepite ku
mpamvu iyo ari yo yose, Perezida
w’Umutwe w’Abadepite abimenyesha
Komisiyo kugira ngo itangaze amazina
y’Umudepite usimbura
(4) Komisiyo itangariza Abanyarwanda
amazina y’Umudepite mushya mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi irindwi ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi Perezida w’Umutwe w’Abadepite
abiyimenyeshereje.
(5) Iyo ari umutwe wa politiki washeshwe,
umwe cyangwa benshi mu Badepite
beguye kandi nta musimbura uri ku ilisiti,
hakoreshwa andi matora yo gusimbura
Abadepite beguye mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 90 ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
Komisiyo yabimenyesherejweho. Iyo
bigenze bityo, buri mutwe wa politiki
cyangwa abakandida bigenga bashobora
gutanga kandidatire kuri uwo mwanya mu
buryo busanzwe buteganyijwe igihe iyo
myanya ipiganirwa.
(a) inyandiko itanga kandidatire
igaragaza–
(i) amazina ye yose ahwanye n’ari ku
ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(ii) ifasi ashaka kwiyamamarizamo iyo
ari mu cyiciro cy’Abasenateri
batorwa hakurikijwe inzego
z’imitegekere y’Igihugu;
(iii) n’icyiciro ashaka
kwiyamamarizamo iyo ari mu
basenateri batorwa mu mashuri
makuru.
(b) umwirondoro ugaragaza –
(i) umurimo akora;
(ii) aho yavukiye;
(iii)itariki y’amavuko;
(iv)n’aho aba.
(c) icyemezo cy’amavuko gitangwa
n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha;
(d) icyemezo cy’imyitwarire myiza
gitangwa n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha;
(e) amafoto ye abiri magufi y’amabara;
(f) kopi y’ikarita ndangamuntu ye;
(g) icyemezo kigaragaza ko umuntu
yakatiwe cyangwa atakatiwe n’inkiko
kitarengeje igihe, gitangwa n’urwego
rubifitiye ububasha;
(h) icyemezo cya muganga wemewe;
(i) kopi y’impamyabumenyi nibura
y’icyiciro cya mbere cya Kaminuza
cyangwa ihwanye na yo iriho
umukono wa noteri cyangwa icyemezo
cy’uko yakoze imirimo yo mu rwego
rwo hejuru muri Leta cyangwa mu
rwego rw’abikorera;
(j) n’inyandiko ye yashyizeho umukono
cyangwa igikumwe yemeza ko
inyandiko yasabwe kandi yatanze ari
ukuri.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa by’umwihariko abakandida ku myanya y’Abasenateri batorwa mu mashuri makuru (1) Abakandida b’Abasenateri batorwa mu
articles.text:
mashuri makuru ya Leta n’ayigenga baba
ari abarimu cyangwa abashakashatsi ku
buryo buhoraho muri ayo mashuri makuru
bari ku rwego nibura rw’umwarimu
wungirije.
(2) Umukandida ushaka kwiyamamariza kuba
Umusenateri mu basenateri batorwa mu
mashuri makuru ya Leta n’ayigenga
ashyikiriza Komisiyo ibi bikurikira:
(a) icyemezo cy’uko akora ku buryo
buhoraho cyatanzwe n’ishuri
rikuru rya Leta cyangwa ryigenga;
(b) inyandiko yemeza ko yashyizwe
nibura ku rwego rw’umwarimu
wungirije.
(3) Iyo Umusenateri wari waratowe mu
mashuri makuru ashaka kwiyamamariza
manda ya kabiri ku mwanya
w’Umusenateri utorwa mu mashuri
makuru, ntasabwa ibyangombwa
biteganywa mu gika cya (2)(a) iyo manda
ashaka kwiyamamariza ikurikirana n’iyo
arimo.

articles.heading: Iyemezwa ry’urutonde rw’abakandida b’Abasenateri batorwa (1) Kandidatire z’Abasenateri batorwa
articles.text:
zemezwa n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga.
(2) Komisiyo ishyikiriza Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
amadosiye y’abakandida b’Abasenateri
yakiriye, urutonde rwabo n’uko ibona buri
kandidatire, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi itatu
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi w’ihagarikwa
ry’iyakira rya kandidatire kugira ngo
ruzemeze.
(3) Inyandiko isaba Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
kwemeza kandidatire z’Abasenateri ifatwa
nk’ikirego gishyikirijwe Urukiko. Urukiko
rw’Ikirenga rusuzuma kandi rukemeza
kandidatire z’Abasenateri rwashyikirijwe
mu muhezo, inteko y’abacamanza igizwe
nibura na bibiri bya gatatu by’abacamanza
bagize Urukiko rw’Ikirenga, rugashingira
ku nyandiko n’ibindi byangombwa
bisabwa abakandida b’Abasenateri nk’uko
biteganywa n’amategeko. Icyemezo
cyafashwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
ntikijuririrwa.
(4) Bitarenze iminsi itanu, ibarwa uhereye
igihe Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
rwashyikirijweho amadosiye
y’abakandida b’Abasenateri, Umwanditsi
Mukuru w’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
ashyikiriza Komisiyo urutonde
rw’abakandida b’Abasenateri bemejwe
n’urw’abatemejwe n’amadosiye yabo, na
yo igatangaza ku mugaragaro urutonde
rwemejwe, mu gihe kitarenze amasaha 24
uhereye isaha Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
rwayishyikirijeho kandidatire
z’Abasenateri zemejwe.
(5) Amadosiye y’abakandida b’Abasenateri
ashyingurwa muri Komisiyo.

articles.text:
urwego rubifitiye ububasha rugishyira mu

articles.text:

articles.text:
hamwe n’inyandiko isoza iyandikwa ry’ilisiti

bugenwa na Komisiyo.

articles.text:

Ambasade hagamijwe korohereza abatora.

articles.heading: Iyoherezwa ry’inyandiko mvugo isoza itora n’iy’ibarura ry’amajwi Inyandiko mvugo isoza itora n’iy’ibarura
articles.text:
ry’amajwi zohererezwa Komisiyo mu gihe

hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’itumanaho bugenwa

articles.heading: Inzego z’ubuyobozi zitorerwa ku nzego z’imitegekere y’Igihugu zegerejwe abaturage (1) Itora ry’abayobozi b’inzego z’imitegekere
Uburyo bukoreshwa mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza (1) Kwiyamamaza bikorwa hakoreshejwe imbwirwaruhame, amafoto, inyandiko
articles.text:
n’ikoranabuhanga mu gihe cyabigenewe.
(2) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uko
ibivugwa mu gika cya (1) bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ibibujijwe abiyamamariza ubuyobozi mu nzego z’imitegekere y’Igihugu zegerejwe abaturage Mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza, ibikorwa
articles.text:
bikurikira birabujijwe:
(a) kwiyamamariza umwanya
w’ubuyobozi mu izina ry’umutwe wa
politiki;
(b) kumanika amafoto, inyandiko no
gukorera ibindi bikorwa byo
kwiyamamaza ahatabigenewe;
(c) gukoresha ibiranga Igihugu n’ibiranga
imitwe ya politiki ku mafoto no ku
nyandiko byamamaza umukandida.

articles.heading: Icyemezo gifatirwa umukandida wiyamamaza mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’andi mategeko,
articles.text:
uwiyamamaza mu buryo bunyuranyije
n’ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko ngenga
arihanangirizwa, atakwisubiraho agakurwa
mu bakandida.

articles.heading: Gutsinda itora (1) Ku rwego rwatoreweho, abakandida barushije abandi amajwi ni bo baba batsinze hashingiwe ku mubare
articles.text:
w’imyanya itorerwa.
(2) Icyakora, iyo hari abakandida banganyije
amajwi kandi bahatanira umwanya umwe,
hakoreshwa irindi tora hagati
y’abanganyije amajwi mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi itatu ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
ibyavuye mu itora rya mbere
byatangarijweho.
(3) Itora risubirwamo inshuro imwe. Iyo nta
gihindutse hakoreshwa tombora kugira
ngo hamenyekane umukandida
wegukanye umwanya.
(4) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena uburyo
gusubiramo itora no gukora tombora
bikorwa.

articles.heading: Isimburwa ry’abatowe (1) Iyo umuntu watowe agize impamvu imubuza gukomeza imirimo yatorewe,
articles.text:
hasigaye nibura umwaka umwe ngo
manda yatorewe irangire, asimburwa
hakoreshejwe itora.
(2) Icyakora, iyo abantu barenze umwe
batowe bagize impamvu ibabuza
gukomeza imirimo batorewe, bigatuma
ifatwa ry’ibyemezo ku bwiganze
ridashoboka, basimburwa hakoreshejwe
itora hatitawe ku gihe cya manda gisigaye
giteganywa mu gika cya (1).
(3) Minisitiri ufite ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu mu
nshingano ageza kuri Komisiyo umwanya
ukeneye gutorerwa mu rwego rwo
gusimbura umuntu uvuye mu mwanya
yari yaratorewe, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
30 umuntu avuye mu mwanya.
(4) Itora ryo gusimbuza umuyobozi utakiri
mu mwanya yari yaratorewe rikorwa mu
gihe kitarenze iminsi 60 ibarwa uhereye
ku munsi Komisiyo
yabimenyesherejweho.
(5) Iyo manda y’uwatowe irangiye hari
inzitizi ntarengwa ituma itora ridashobora
gukorwa, umuntu uri muri uwo mwanya
akomeza gukora inshingano ze kugeza
igihe inzitizi ntarengwa itagihari.
(6) Minisitiri ufite ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu mu
nshingano, amaze kubijyaho inama na
Komisiyo, ashyiraho Iteka rimenyesha ko
itora risubitswe kubera inzitizi ntarengwa.
Mu gihe inzitizi itagihari, Iteka rya
Minisitiri ufite ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu mu
nshingano rirabimenyesha.
(7) Iyo hari inzitizi ntarengwa cyangwa indi
mbogamizi ituma itora ridashobora
gukorwa mu buryo buteganyijwe n’iri
tegeko ngenga, Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite
ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu mu nshingano,
amaze kubijyaho inama na Komisiyo,
rishobora gushyiraho ubundi buryo iryo
tora rikorwamo.
Icyiciro cya 2: Itora ry’abayobozi ku rwego
rw’Umudugudu, urw’Akagari
n’urw’Umurenge

articles.heading: Uburyo itora ry’abayobozi ku rwego rw’Umudugudu, urw’Akagari n’urw’Umurenge rikorwa Itora ry’abayobozi ku rwego rw’Umudugudu,
articles.text:
urw’Akagari n’urw’Umurenge rishobora
gukorwa mu buryo butari ibanga.

articles.heading: Abagize inteko itora n’ibisabwa abakandida ku myanya y’ubuyobozi Iteka rya Perezida rigena ibisabwa abakandida
articles.text:
biyamamariza kujya mu nzego z’ubuyobozi
ku rwego rw’Umudugudu, urw’Akagari
n’urw’Umurenge n’abagize inteko zitora kuri
buri rwego.

articles.heading: Gukemura ibibazo byerekeranye n’imigendekere y’itora (1) Mu itora ry’abayobozi ku rwego rw’Umudugudu, urw’Akagari
articles.text:
n’urw’Umurenge, ibibazo byose
bikomoka ku mirimo y’itora bihita
bishyikirizwa umuyobozi w’itora ku
rwego riberaho, agahita abikemurira mu
ruhame imbere y’abaturage aho itora
ryabereye kandi bigashyirwa mu nyandiko
mvugo.
(2) Iyo ikibazo kidashyikirijwe umuyobozi
w’itora kuri urwo rwego, itora rikirangira,
ntikiba kicyakiriwe.
Icyiciro cya 3: Itora ry’abayobozi ku rwego
rw’Akarere no ku rw’Umujyi wa Kigali
Akiciro ka mbere: Inama Njyanama
y’Akarere n’iy’Umujyi wa Kigali

articles.heading: Imirimo itabangikanywa n’uw’ubujyanama ku rwego rw’Akarere cyangwa urw’Umujyi wa Kigali (1) Imirimo itabangikanywa
Ibisabwa utanga kandidatire ku mwanya w’ubujyanama ku rwego rw’Akarere cyangwa urw’Umujyi wa Kigali
articles.text:
Umukandida ku mwanya w’ubujyanama ku
rwego rw’Akarere cyangwa urw’Umujyi wa
Kigali aba yujuje ibi bikurikira:
(a) kuba ari Umunyarwanda;
(b) afite nibura imyaka 21 y’amavuko;
(c) atazitiwe n’imwe mu ngingo z’iri
tegeko ngenga.

articles.heading: Itangwa rya kandidatire (1) Gutanga kandidatire bikorwa mu nyandiko hashingiwe ku mabwiriza ya Komisiyo
articles.text:
kandi bitangirwa icyemezo cy’iyakira.
(2) Inyandiko itanga kandidatire igaragaza ibi
bikurikira:
(a) amazina ahuye n’ari ku ikarita
ndangamuntu ye cyangwa ku kindi
cyemezo kigaragaza ko ari
Umunyarwanda gitangwa n’urwego
rubifitiye ububasha;
(b) umwanya n’Akarere ashaka
kwiyamamarizamo.

articles.heading: Inyandiko ziherekeza kandidatire Kandidatire iherekezwa n’ibi bikurikira
Imenyesha ry’ahazakorerwa igikorwa cyo kwiyamamaza kw’abakandida mu Nama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi
articles.text:
wa Kigali
(1) Umukandida ku mwanya w’ubujyanama
mu Nama Njyanama y’Akarere ushaka
kwiyamamaza hakoreshejwe inama
cyangwa amakoraniro abimenyesha mu
nyandiko ubuyobozi bw’Akarere
yiyamamarizamo hasigaye nibura
amasaha 24 kugira ngo bikorwe,
akagenera kopi umuhuzabikorwa
w’amatora ku rwego rw’Akarere.
(2) Ku bajyanama b’Umujyi wa Kigali
batorwa, umukandida ushaka
kwiyamamaza hakoreshejwe inama
cyangwa amakoraniro abimenyesha mu
nyandiko ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ko mu
Mujyi wa Kigali yiyamamarizamo
hasigaye nibura amasaha 24 kugira ngo
bikorwe, akagenera kopi
umuhuzabikorwa w’amatora ku rwego
rw’ako Karere.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena itariki
n’igihe ibikorwa byo kwiyamamaza
bikorwamo.

articles.heading: Umubare w’abajyanama batorwa mu Nama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi wa Kigali (1) Umubare w’abajyanama mu Nama
articles.text:
Njyanama y’Akarere batorwa ugenwa
n’itegeko rigenga Akarere.
(2) Umubare w’abajyanama mu nama
Njyanama y’Umujyi wa Kigali batorwa
ugenwa n’itegeko rigenga Umujyi wa
Kigali.

articles.heading: Itorwa ry’abajyanama rusange n’abajyanama b’abagore ku rwego rw’Akarere (1) Ku rwego rw’Akarere, abajyanama
articles.text:
rusange n’abajyanama b’abagore bangana
nibura na 30% by’abagomba kugira Inama
Njyanama y’Akarere, batorwa mu buryo
buziguye kandi mu ibanga.
(2) Iteka rya Perezida rigena abagize inteko
itora.

articles.heading: Itorwa ry’abagize Inama Njyanama batorerwa mu Karere ko mu Mujyi wa Kigali (1) Abajyanama b’Umujyi wa Kigali
articles.text:
batorerwa muri buri Karere k’Umujyi wa
Kigali batorwa ku buryo buziguye kandi
mu ibanga.
(2) Iteka rya Perezida rigena abagize inteko
itora.
Akiciro ka 2: Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere
n’iy’Umujyi wa Kigali

articles.heading: Itangwa rya kandidatire ku myanya yo muri Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere n’iy’Umujyi wa Kigali Gutanga kandidatire ku myanya yo muri
articles.text:
Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere n’iy’Umujyi wa
Kigali bikorwa ku munsi w’itora imbere
y’abagize inteko itora.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gutora abagize Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere n’iy’Umujyi wa Kigali Itora ry’abagize Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere
articles.text:
n’iy’Umujyi wa Kigali rikorwa mu buryo
buziguye kandi mu ibanga.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa umuntu ushaka kwiyamamariza kujya muri Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi wa
articles.text:
Kigali
(1) Umuntu ushaka kwiyamamariza kujya
muri Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere cyangwa
iy’Umujyi wa Kigali aba –
(a) ari mu bagize Inama Njyanama
y’Akarere bireba cyangwa iy’Umujyi
wa Kigali;
(b) afite nibura impamyabumenyi
cyangwa impamyabushobozi
by’icyiciro cya mbere cy’ishuri rikuru
yemewe n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha;
(c) kandi afite nibura imyaka 25
y’amavuko ku mwanya w’umuyobozi
w’Akarere cyangwa afite nibura
imyaka 35 ku mwanya w’Umuyobozi
w’Umujyi wa Kigali.
(2) Icyakora, umuntu wujuje ibisabwa mu
gika cya (1)(a) na (c) ufite nibura
impamyabumenyi cyangwa
impamyabushobozi y’amashuri atandatu
yisumbuye yemewe n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha n’uburambe nibura bw’imyaka
itanu mu buyobozi ashobora kwemererwa
kwiyamamaza.

articles.heading: Abagize inteko itora Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi wa Kigali Iteka rya Perezida rigena abagize inteko itora
articles.text:
Komite Nyobozi y’Akarere cyangwa
iy’Umujyi wa Kigali.
Akiciro ka 3: Biro y’Inama Njyanama
y’Akarere n’iy’Umujyi wa Kigali

articles.heading: Itangwa rya kandidatire ku mwanya w’abagize Biro y’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi
articles.text:
wa Kigali
Gutanga kandidatire ku mwanya w’abagize
Biro y’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa
iy’Umujyi wa Kigali bikorwa ku munsi
w’itora, imbere y’abagize Inama Njyanama.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa umukandida wiyamamariza umwanya w’abagize Biro y’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi wa Kigali
articles.text:
(1) Umukandida wiyamamariza umwanya
w’abagize Biro y’Inama Njyanama
y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi wa Kigali,
aba –
(a) ari umujyanama kuri urwo rwego;
(b) afite nibura imyaka 25 y’amavuko;
(c) kandi afite nibura
impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya
mbere cy’ishuri rikuru yemewe
n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Icyakora, umuntu wujuje ibisabwa mu
gika cya 1(a) na (b) ufite nibura
impamyabumenyi cyangwa
impamyabushobozi y’amashuri atandatu
yisumbuye yemewe n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha n’uburambe nibura bw’imyaka
itanu mu buyobozi ashobora kwemererwa
kwiyamamaza.

articles.heading: Itora ry’abagize Biro y’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa iy’Umujyi wa Kigali Abagize Inama Njyanama y’Akarere cyangwa
articles.text:
iy’Umujyi wa Kigali bitoramo Biro igizwe na
Perezida, Visi Perezida n’Umunyamabanga
hakurikijwe amabwiriza ya Komisiyo.
Akiciro ka 4: Gukemura impaka zivutse mu
itora ku rwego rw’Akarere cyangwa
urw’Umujyi wa Kigali

articles.heading: Inzego zifite ububasha mu ikemura ry’impaka zirebana na kandidatire (1) Utanyuzwe n’icyemezo cyafashwe kuri
articles.text:
kandidatire n’urwego rwa Komisiyo
rwakiriye iyo kandidatire ajuririra urwego
rwisumbuye hakurikijwe uko zirutana, mu
gihe kitarenze amasaha 24 abarwa uhereye
igihe icyemezo gifatiwe.
(2) Icyemezo cyafashwe n’urwego
rwajuririwe kigaragaza icyo gishingiyeho
kandi kigatangwa mu gihe kitarenze
amasaha 48 abarwa uhereye igihe
rwashyikirijwe ikirego.
(3) Icyemezo cyafashwe na Komisiyo ku
rwego rw’Igihugu gishobora kuregerwa
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha mu gihe
kitarenze amasaha 24 abarwa uhereye
igihe icyemezo cyafatiwe. Icyakora, kuba
icyo kirego cyashyikirijwe urukiko
ntibihagarika imigendekere y’ibikorwa
by’itora.

articles.heading: Urwego rutakambirwa ku kibazo cy’ibyavuye mu matora (1) Ku rwego rwa mbere, ugize ikibazo ku
articles.text:
byavuye mu itora atakambira urwego rwa
Komisiyo itora ryabereyeho, ako kanya
nyuma yo gutangaza ibyavuye mu itora.
Icyemezo gifatwa ako kanya kigatangazwa
mu ruhame.
(2) Icyemezo cyafashwe kigaragaza
ibyashingiweho mu kugifata kandi
kigakorerwa inyandiko mvugo ishyirwaho
umukono n’impande zombi.
(3) Amabwiriza ya Komisiyo agena imiterere
y’inyandiko mvugo iteganywa mu gika
cya (2).

articles.heading: Urwego rujuririrwa (1) Iyo uwatanze ikibazo atanyuzwe n’icyemezo cyafashwe n’urwego itora ryabereyeho, ajuririra mu nyandiko
articles.text:
Komisiyo, mu gihe kitarenze amasaha 24
abarwa uhereye igihe cyatangarijwe.
(2) Komisiyo itanga igisubizo mu masaha 24
abarwa uhereye igihe yashyikirijwe
ikibazo.

articles.heading: Itora ry’abayobozi b’Inama z’Igihugu Itora ry’abayobozi b’Inama z’Igihugu ni itora ry’abagize Komite Nyobozi y’Inama
articles.text:
y’Igihugu y’Abagore, iry’abagize Komite
Nyobozi y’Inama y’Igihugu y’Urubyiruko
n’iry’abagize Komite Nyobozi y’Inama
y’Igihugu y’Abantu bafite ubumuga, mu
nzego z’imitegekere y’Igihugu.

articles.heading: Imigendekere y’amatora Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe rigena uko amatora y’abagize Komite Nyobozi ya buri
articles.text: Nama y’Igihugu akorwa.

articles.heading: Ikomeza ry’inshingano mu gihe cy’inzitizi ntarengwa (1) Iyo manda y’abatowe mu nzego z’Inama
articles.text:
z’Igihugu irangiye hari inzitizi ntarengwa
ituma amatora adashobora gukorwa,
umuntu uri muri uwo mwanya akomeza
gukora inshingano ze kugeza igihe inzitizi
ntarengwa itagihari.
(2) Minisitiri ufite ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu mu
nshingano amaze kubijyaho inama na
Komisiyo ashyiraho iteka rimenyesha ko
ayo matora asubitswe kubera inzitizi
ntarengwa. Iyo inzitizi ntarengwa
itagihari, Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite
ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu mu nshingano
rirabimenyesha.
UMUTWE WA VIII: AMATORA YA
KOMITE Y’ABUNZI

articles.heading: Abagize Komite y’Abunzi n’inzego batorerwaho Umubare w’abagize Komite y’Abunzi n’inzego z’imitegekere y’Igihugu
articles.text:
batorerwaho bigenwa n’Itegeko rigena
imitunganyirize, ifasi, ububasha n’imikorere
bya Komite y’Abunzi.
kugerageza guhindura imitekerereze
y’ugomba gutora aba akoze icyaha. Iyo
abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa ihazabu
itari munsi ya FRW 200.000 ariko itarenze
FRW 500.000 cyangwa igifungo kitari
munsi y’amezi 3 ariko kitageze ku mezi 6.

articles.heading: Gukoresha ibiranga Igihugu cyangwa ibirango by’umutwe wa politiki mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko mu kwiyamamaza
articles.text:
(1) Umuntu, mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza mu
itora iryo ari ryo ryose, ukoresha ibiranga
Igihugu ku mafoto no ku nyandiko
byamamaza umukandida, aba akoze
icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanishwa ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW
50.000 ariko itarenze FRW 100.000.
(2) Umuntu ukoresha ibirango by’imitwe ya
politiki mu kwiyamamaza mu itora
riziguye ry’abagize Inteko Ishinga
Amategeko, mu itora ry’abayobozi
b’inzego z’imitegekere y’Igihugu
zegerejwe abaturage cyangwa
uwiyamamaza mu izina ry’umutwe wa
kitarenze umwaka 1.
(4) Iyo icyaha giteganywa mu gika (1) n’icya
(2) gikozwe biturutse ku mugambi
wumvikanyweho, igihano kiba igifungo
kitari munsi y’umwaka 1 ariko kitarenze
imyaka 3.

articles.heading: Kwitwara nabi k’uri mu nteko itora hagamijwe kwica itora (1) Umuntu uri mu bagize inteko itora mu gihe
articles.text:
cy’ibikorwa by’itora, ugaragaweho
gutesha agaciro cyangwa kugirira nabi uri
mu bayobora amatora cyangwa se
ukoresha iterabwoba, ugerageza
kuburizamo ibikorwa by’itora, aba akoze
icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanishwa ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW
100.000 ariko itarenze FRW 300.000
cyangwa igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi 2
ariko kitarenze amezi 6.
(2) Iyo icyaha giteganywa mu gika cya (1)
gitumye itora riburizwamo, igihano kiba
ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 500.000 ariko
itarenze FRW 2.000.000 cyangwa
igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi 6 ariko
kitarenze umwaka 1.
ariko kitarenze imyaka 2.

articles.heading: Kwamburwa uburenganzira bwo gutora (1) Urukiko rushobora kwambura uburenganzira bwo gutora mu gihe
articles.text:
kitarenze imyaka 5 umuntu ukoze kimwe
mu byaha biteganyijwe muri uyu mutwe
gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kirenze
imyaka 2.
(2) Iyo uwakoze icyaha ari umukozi wa
Komisiyo, umukozi woherejwe na Leta
cyangwa uhagarariye umutwe wa politiki,
igihe cyo kwamburwa uburenganzira bwo
gutora gishobora kugera ku myaka 10.
